Nighttime biology remains UNKNOWN. Direct Hazcams sessions at 03:08–03:09 CDT advanced across two samples about 41.9 seconds apart with visible flag/vehicle progression and no human/light event signal; Fairhope beaches are not visible. Fresh 03Z NGOFS2 MODEL guidance now shows shoreward antecedent transport (+66 m 1h, +144 m 3h, +166 m 6h), followed by modestly seaward 1–3h guidance (-23 m, -35 m), a small shoreward 6h interval (+40 m), and seaward 12h guidance (-121 m).
